dedupe_keys.name: flacs cfd fire explosion and dispersion modelling software

description: FLACS is Gexcon's computational fluid dynamics tool for safety professionals, used to predict and mitigate the consequences of fires, explosions and toxic gas dispersion in complex industrial facilities. It models detailed three-dimensional geometries, simulates hazard scenarios and what-if cases to optimise layouts and mitigation, and is validated against experimental and real-world data from more than 40 years of research. Gexcon positions it for hydrogen, ammonia, carbon capture and renewable energy systems as well as oil and gas, LNG, chemicals and manufacturing, and sells it within an X-Suite with the EFFECTS consequence and RISKCURVES quantitative risk tools, with simulation modules, use cases, case studies, a user group and customer support. Use is global, including COMAH, Seveso, DSEAR and ATEX compliance work. Access is commercial through Gexcon, with no prices on the page read. Caveats: CFD runs need expert set-up and computing time, and the software is proprietary. For simulation it gives high-fidelity consequence fields of accidental releases for facility siting, natech and emergency planning around industrial and energy infrastructure. Related catalogue records include ALOHA and RAPID-N.
